Title: ITALIAN NATIONALS - TURIN, ITALY - FEB 06-07 2016  - Save the date!

Messages.Author: Luke71
Messages.Body:
Fellow Methuselah, the time for the first Italian major events has arrived!
VTES Turin (organizer comunity) is proud to announce date and details for the 2 days of tournaments.

On saturday we have a Constructed Tournament that give the qualification only at the winner.
On sunday we have the ITALIAN NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP that give the qualifications to all the finalist, and give them A FREE ADMISSION FOR THE GENOA EC2016 AS A PRIZE!

Saturday, February 6 2016
Turin constructed tournament
Where: Collegno (TO)
Venue: Circolo Terracorta Collegno - Corso Togliatti 65, Collegno (TO)
Format: Constructed
Round: 2 + Final
Time Limit: 2h
Fee: 8.00 €
Prize Finalist: Sleeves
Prize Winner: Deck protector and GENOA EC2016 qualification

Sunday, February 7 2016
ITALIAN NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2016
Where: Collegno (TO)
Venue: Circolo Terracorta Collegno - Corso Togliatti 65, Collegno (TO)
Format: Constructed
Round: 3 + Final
Time Limit: 2h
Fee: 10.00 €
Prize Finalist: QUALIFICATION AND FREE ADMISSION FOR THE GENOA EC2016
Prize Winner: ALBUM PORTFOLIO, QUALIFICATION AND FREE ADMISSION FOR THE GENOA EC2016
************************************************************************************************

EXTRA PRIZES FOR BOTH TOURNAMENTS:
- a complete ANARCHS UNBOUND expansion for every GW (1x for each cards print);
- VTES Turin T-shirts to a winner of the "B FINAL" (organized from our community for this event, for the players qualified from 6th to 10th position);

************************************************************************************************

- www.italybynight.org/portale/index.php?option=com_kunena&func=view&catid=1&id=97116&Itemid=167 (our forum)
- Facebook www.facebook.com/events/774200842714474/
- you can contact me at
************************************************************************************************

So I really hope to see many of you here!

On behalf of all the Italian community, especially Turin community, I wish you a great 2016 and we wait to meet you soon!
Let them bleed!

Luca Visona'
